evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Arden: 'I need to ask you questions that will take around ten to fifteen minutes so I can give you a realistic number estimate' — framing present but no explicit wait for yes; customer volunteers 'A realistic number' without being asked to confirm.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Zip codes (75235 from, 75072 to), move date (October 14-17), origin/destination (Dallas to McKinney), size (10x10 storage unit) all gathered.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep moves directly into logistics probing without ever asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (storage unit), size (10x10), and contents (boxes + 3 pieces furniture) covered. Missing: floor/stories (N/A for storage), number of rooms (N/A for storage), walking distance, additional rooms, additional stops.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Arden: '$204 per hour for two movers and one truck... $687 to $891' with typical time range. Personalized to storage unit scenario and distance.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Arden: 'Everything is already included in the hourly rate. Gas trucks, taxes, insurance, all the wraps, the bags and bans... only thing outside that our rate is a one time... Transportation fee of $75... there are no hidden fees... no credit card fees, no sterle fees, and no disassemble or assembly fees.' Full fee transparency and 'not a guess' framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked. Call ends abruptly after customer says 'that's very high. Alright, thank you, thank you.'
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Not asked. Call ends without checking for remaining concerns.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' Call terminates mid-objection without closing attempt.

top_strength: Arden gathered all four discovery basics cleanly (zip codes, move date, route, property type/size) and delivered a transparent, itemized pricing frame with no hidden fees upfront.
coaching_note: Section 2 (Their Agenda) was never asked—this is the load-bearing question that uncovers what the customer actually cares about beyond price; without it, the rep can't personalize the pitch or address real objections. Additionally, Sections 5, 6, and 7 were abandoned entirely (no promises delivered, no final concerns check, no explicit ask for the business), leaving the sale incomplete.
